metadata.name: AI Plant · ถนนละเอียด ภาคตะวันออกเฉียงเหนือ
metadata.license: Underlying geographic data OpenStreetMap ODbL 1.0; bundled source.geojsonseq.gz
metadata.description: Actual OSM major/minor roads, residential/service roads, farm tracks, paths, waterways and place names. No satellite imagery, invented farm entrances or routing.

method: disk-backed feature RTree, 8x8 metatiles, native AGG antialiased paths and 2x shaped Thai labels, PNG lossless, resumable transactions, CPU affinity 2 below normal
memory_scope: Recorded renderer RAM is the main process only, excludes worker processes, browser and Pi runtime. PC preparation only.
